reelection.rule: Rule: next even-year November for this House term. legislators-current.yaml ends the current term on 2027-01-03. The even-year November before that January 3 end is November 2026. The file has no election day, so no day of the month is shown.

votes.bill_title: Stop Insider Trading Act
votes.plain_language: This bill generally bars members of Congress and their spouses and dependent children from buying stocks, and it requires public notice before they sell. A Yea passes it in the House. A Nay votes against passage.

votes.question: On Motion to Recommit — Stop Insider Trading Act (H R 7008)
votes.bill_title: Stop Insider Trading Act
votes.plain_language: The Stop Insider Trading Act would bar members of Congress and their spouses and dependent children from buying stocks and would require public notice before a sale. votes.bill_title: National Defense Authorization Act for Fiscal Year 2027
votes.plain_language: This amendment would have required the Defense Secretary to report options for cutting the department's civilian workforce by 200,000. A Yea would have added that report. A Nay voted not to add it.

votes.question: On Agreeing to the Amendment (H R 8800)
votes.bill_title: National Defense Authorization Act for Fiscal Year 2027
votes.plain_language: This amendment to the fiscal year 2027 defense bill would ban automated speed-enforcement cameras on military bases. A Yea adds that ban to the bill. A Nay leaves the bill without it.

votes.bill_title: National Defense Authorization Act for Fiscal Year 2027

A Yea supports adopting it; a Nay opposes it.

votes.bill_title: Sharri Briley and Eric Edmundson Veterans Benefits Expansion Act of 2026
votes.plain_language: This bill expands specified benefits programs for veterans and their survivors and establishes a supplemental monthly allowance for certain disabled veterans. A Yea supports passing it in the House; a Nay opposes it.

votes.question: On Passage — Veterans 2nd Amendment Protection Act (H R 1041)
votes.bill_title: Veterans 2nd Amendment Protection Act
votes.plain_language: This bill prohibits the Department of Veterans Affairs from transmitting certain information to the National Instant Criminal Background Check System utilized by licensed importers or dealers of firearms. A Yea supports passing it in the House; a Nay opposes it.

votes.question: On Motion to Recommit — Veterans 2nd Amendment Protection Act (H R 1041)
votes.bill_title: Veterans 2nd Amendment Protection Act
votes.plain_language: H.R. 1041 (Veterans 2nd Amendment Protection Act) prohibits the Department of Veterans Affairs from transmitting certain information to the National Instant Criminal Background Check System utilized by licensed importers or dealers of firearms. A motion to recommit is the minority's last formal chance to send a bill back to committee before the passage vote. A Yea supports sending it back; a Nay keeps it on the floor for the passage vote.

votes.question: On Motion to Suspend the Rules and Pass — Fiscal Year 2025 Veterans Affairs Major Medical Facility Authorization Act (S 2393)
votes.bill_title: Fiscal Year 2025 Veterans Affairs Major Medical Facility Authorization Act
votes.plain_language: This bill authorizes the Department of Veterans Affairs to carry out a major medical facility project in St. Louis, Missouri, during FY2026. This vote was under suspension of the rules, so a two-thirds vote was required. A Yea supports passing it; a Nay opposes it.

votes.question: On Motion to Suspend the Rules and Pass — To amend the FISA Amendments Act of 2008 to extend the authorities of title VII of the Foreign Intelligence Surveillance Act of 1978, and for other purposes (S 4465)
votes.bill_title: A bill to amend the FISA Amendments Act of 2008 to extend the authorities of title VII of the Foreign Intelligence Surveillance Act of 1978, and for other purposes.
votes.plain_language: This bill extends the authorities of Title VII of the Foreign Intelligence Surveillance Act until June 12, 2026. This vote was under suspension of the rules, so a two-thirds vote was required. A Yea supports passing it; a Nay opposes it.

votes.question: On Passage — Fallen Servicemembers Religious Heritage Restoration Act (S 1318)
votes.bill_title: Fallen Servicemembers Religious Heritage Restoration Act
votes.plain_language: This bill carries the Foreign Intelligence Accountability Act and the Anti-CBDC Surveillance State Act as passed by the House; it reauthorizes Title VII of the Foreign Intelligence Surveillance Act until April 30, 2029, with added protections related to Section 702, and bars Federal Reserve banks from issuing a central bank digital currency or offering accounts directly to individuals. A Yea supports passing it in the House; a Nay opposes it.

votes.question: On Motion to Suspend the Rules and Pass, as Amended — Ernest Peltz Accrued Veterans Benefits Act (H R 3123)
votes.bill_title: Ernest Peltz Accrued Veterans Benefits Act
votes.plain_language: This bill establishes procedures for the Department of Veterans Affairs to issue a pension that was due but unpaid at the time of a veteran’s death. This vote was under suspension of the rules, so a two-thirds vote was required. A Yea supports passing it as amended; a Nay opposes it.

votes.question: On Motion to Suspend the Rules and Pass, as Amended — Veterans Readiness and Employment Improvement Act (H R 980)
votes.bill_title: Veterans Readiness and Employment Improvement Act of 2025
votes.plain_language: This bill removes the requirement that educational and vocational counseling services provided by the Department of Veterans Affairs on campus at institutions of higher learning must be provided by VA counselors. This vote was under suspension of the rules, so a two-thirds vote was required. A Yea supports passing it as amended; a Nay opposes it.

posts.text:
A Venezuelan billionaire allegedly paid $50 million to Trump lawyer Alina Habba Mildon.

Weeks later, Trump pardoned him for his bribery conviction. 

When Trump learned about the payout, he said to give the money to his library. Abolish the pardon power. Hold Trump accountable. https://t.co/F4jJGQGtIE

Lowering the Medicare age to 50 would cost $180 billion a year. That's $70 billion less than the budget increase the House passed for the Department of War.

We could have healthcare over warfare.

I'm proud to cosponsor @RepJayapal's bill to lower the age from 65 to 50.

One year ago, the fall of El Fasher to the RSF led to a devastating genocide and ethnic cleansing against civilians in Darfur. Tens of thousands of innocent Sudanese were lost, and thousands more displaced. 

Silence is not an option. 

Congress must lead efforts to demand an immediate ceasefire, deliver life-saving aid, appoint a Special Envoy, and hold the RSF and its backers accountable.

I'm introducing the Truth and Accounability Commission to hold the Trump administration and Trump family accountable for their crimes.

No one is above the law. https://t.co/QRIDRB6fzV

Beverly and Jeff Morris lived in peace and quiet on their beautiful farm before Meta broke ground on a data center complex next door. Now, they don't have clean drinking water and are dealing with constant noise pollution. 

Stories like the Morrises are exactly why we need a https://t.co/Bb4yp2NP8a

Hickory, North Carolina used to be the furniture capital of the world. After China flooded the market, Sherrill Furniture is one of the last factories left.

I visited Hickory and saw the impact of the China Shock firsthand. We need an American Industrial Bank so companies like Sherrill can grow and a new generation of furniture craftsman can prosper.

I spoke with Daria and Alevtina Soboleva after Alevtina was kidnapped by ICE and detained for weeks despite having a pending asylum application and no criminal history.

My team helped locate her and worked to secure medical care while she was detained. During her detention, she was denied basic necessities, including access to a bathroom.

We need to abolish ICE and establish humanitarian standards in our immigration system.

I joined the Manufacturing Solutions Center and the Industrial Commons for a roundtable on how to rebuild American manufacturing and combat Chinese subsidies. Companies alone cannot compete against countries. 

North Carolina used to lead the world in textiles and furniture. If Congress gets to work, it can once again.

As Co-Chair of the US India Caucus, I'm joining @RepMcCormick in calling on the DOJ and FBI to investigate this as a potential federal hate crime and hold those responsible accountable.

The attempted mass shooting at a Hindu temple in Aurora, Illinois is horrifying. Every American deserves to worship without fear.
https://t.co/CkJovhBSL7

This week, I visited Spruce Pine, North Carolina, which mines most of the world’s high purity quartz to build semiconductors and solar panels. To outcompete China in high tech and clean energy, we need rural communities like Spruce Pine to thrive.

On the China Committee, I’m committed to an American critical minerals moonshot. Thank you to Sibelco and its workers for showing me around.

Hurricane Helene devastated Western North Carolina. Long after the TV cameras left, two years later, volunteers in Spruce Pine are still rebuilding. 

I met with volunteers, Mayor Holmes, local leaders, and representatives of Sen. Budd’s office to discuss how Congress can help. Thank you to the families who shared their stories of resilience, rebuilding, and faith.

When the paper mill in Canton, North Carolina shut down, over 1,000 people lost their jobs. It’s the same story in rural communities across America due to unfair Chinese trade practices.

I met with Mayor Smathers and other local leaders to discuss how to reindustrialize America and help communities rebuild.

Trump just announced that he's backing away from the live streamed public exeucution.

Hegseth is so extreme that even Trump realizes he needs to rein him in.

Today, I'm cosponsoring @RepVindman's bill to ban the broadcasting public executions. https://t.co/sG3VslxhKk

Peanut farmers are hurting because China is no longer buying our peanuts. 

The Chinese purchasing of our peanuts has fallen from $75 million in 2024 to less than $20 million in 2025 because of Trump's tariff war.

The Iran war has also led to a skyrocketing of diesel costs and equipment cost.

We need to push to open markets in China for our farmers. That is why I visited peanut farmers this week in Dawson, GA.

I appreciate @SanfordBishop’s leadership and support for American cotton growers. We’ll work together to ensure polyester is also banned from Xinjiang and push China to buy more American cotton. U.S. cotton exports to China fell by 4 million bales from 2023/4 to just 800,000 this past year. We need to stand up for American farmers.

The war in Iran continues and Congress is on vacation until November. 
 Gas prices are well over $4. Diesel prices are over $6.

I’m demanding that Congress return to Washington and vote to end the war. https://t.co/1C2ZvY09um

Today, we remember all of the victims of the Oct 7th terrorist attack. Thinking of Jon and Rachel Polin, who I had the honor of meeting, and who lost their beloved son Hersh. I pray we can break the cycle of violence and bring a just peace to the Middle East.

I’m reintroducing the Campus Accountability and Safety Act.

This bill would force universities to report sexual assault incidents to the federal government, require clear processes for investigating and reporting sexual assault, and guarantee justice for survivors. https://t.co/sAjBhFArD5

Egypt’s arrest of the six journalists at Matsadaash is a brazen assault on press freedom. 

I agree with Human Rights Watch, Reporters Without Borders and the 80 other groups objecting to “Egyptian authorities’ failure to allow free expression to thrive.”
https://t.co/853RZTxQyp

Our office has officially become the first in the history of the U.S. Congress to sign a long-term union contract.

Incredibly proud of my team and their hard work.

Three simple ideas to stop corruption in government:

✅ Get money out of politics.
✅ Stop insider trading by federal elected officials.
✅ Prosecute the Epstein class. https://t.co/cv9wDyySLb

ChatGPT literally helped plan a mass shooting.

Eight people were killed.

We need to hold the executives of these AI companies civilly and criminally liable when their models cause this kind of catastrophic harm. https://t.co/0ZFpd9XOyx

The tech lords use jargon to confuse.

They count on the tech illiteracy of the elected class.

They hope we won’t look under the hood.

They know they can’t gaslight me.

This is the most comprehensive AI safety legislation to date.

https://t.co/SlyuUMmwtI

I am opposing Section 219, that would integrate our military with Israel’s.

The United States does not have this arrangement with any other country in the world.

We need to stand up for American sovereignty and strip this provision from the final NDAA. https://t.co/wmVG27nT4i

I introduced the Free Childcare for America Act.

This is the boldest childcare proposal we have ever had. 

It would provide free childcare to millions, while giving families the flexibility to choose the form of childcare that works best for them. https://t.co/NFBDquDpWi

Trump went to the UN to say “to the victor belong the spoils” and America should take whatever it can.

I laid out a different vision of American foreign policy during UNGA at Asia Society.

I called for principle over power, a rejection of might makes right, and America being a friend to the world.

https://t.co/JjhNxi6k8m

I asked Dr. Geoffrey Hinton and Lt. Gen. Shanahan if the US has the technical capacity to monitor advanced AI models at frontier labs.

They said no.

We need a new generation of leadership that understands technology and can build this capacity for our government. https://t.co/IxxUAiEubw

As the top Democrat on the China Committee, I'm convening an unprecedented hearing today on what it will take to reach an international AI safety agreement with China.

Trump and Xi Jinping must reach an agreement on AI safety standards at their meeting tomorrow. https://t.co/iWTiKMwUVE

Our government is giving $2.8 billon in bombs to Israel.

How about giving that money to the American people so they can afford food and gas?

I'm tired of this Israel first policy. It's time to put Americans first. https://t.co/FLySl7t0b3
Wishing an easy and meaningful fast to everyone in CA-17 and around the world observing Yom Kippur. G’mar Chatima Tova.

Trump’s illegal war in Iran has cost Americans in food and gas prices an estimated $230 billion.

Today, I introduced the Illegal War Refund Act to put that money back in the pockets of Americans.

The bill would pull the money from the DOD and write checks for $1700 directly to American taxpayers.

funding.heading: Disclosed campaign receipts
funding.detail: Federal cards show the principal campaign committee and OpenFEC totals for one two-year cycle, plus itemized Schedule A contributors. House uses 2026. Senate uses the cycle of the next election (2026, 2028, or 2030). This is not career fundraising and does not include Schedule E outside spending. Governors do not get a federal contribution list.

town_halls.note: There is no national town-hall dataset. Dates are not estimated.

disclosure_note: Disclosed contributions only; donors behind groups that do not report their own donors are not in this feed.
vote_scope: This is not a full career record. The cache is the latest 40 House rolls (2026, rolls 275-314) and 40 Senate votes (119th Congress, session 2, votes 217-256).
